info.title: Munib Tracker API
info.description: Cloud sync, authentication, and backend services for Munib Tracker. Track Your Journey Back to Allah.

accessTokenExpiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token; rotates on every refresh

code.description: Short pairing code for QR / manual entry

expiresAt.description: Unix ms when this pairing expires

claimUrl.description: HTTPS deep link for the phone to open and claim this pairing

session.description: Present when status is ready — TV should persist this session

code.description: Pairing code shown on the TV

accessToken.description: Google OAuth access token from on-device PKCE exchange

identityToken.description: Apple identity token (JWT) from native Sign in with Apple

displayName.description: Given + family name from Apple (first authorization only)

returnUrl.description: Web origin URL to redirect after Apple form_post callback

confirmation.description: Must be the literal string "RESET" to confirm the destructive data reset
Must be the literal string "DELETE" to confirm irreversible closure

deletedAt.description: Set when the record was deleted on another device

contentPath.description: Authenticated content URL (requires bearer token on GET)

contentMeta.description: Identifying fields for the failed content (edition, surah, page, …)

publicKey.description: Web Push VAPID public key, if configured

token.description: Expo push token or web push subscription endpoint

pushToken.description: ActivityKit per-activity APNs token as lowercase hex

target.description: Expo push token, or JSON string of a Web Push subscription
